content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on a project where a [product_name] is connected to a single [product_name] operator device on the front of a control panel. The client is requesting a second remote [product_name] operator device. Is it possible to connect a second operator device using the spare port on the first device so that both would display the same interface from the one [product_name]?
Hi, please refer to the section 'Communication -> Two HMI devices on [product_name] [version_no]' in the documentation. You may find more details in the following resource: [document].
What do you mean by HMI operator device? Do you mean a generic HMI panel or a specific operator panel?
Hello [user_name], thank you for your answer. The product in question is: [article_no] [product_name] operator device. Apologies for the confusion.
The [product_name] basis module is designed to connect only one operator device. Please see the attached reference.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are investigating whether multiple operator panels can be connected to a single controller module for simultaneous HMI access. The current consensus is that only one operator panel can be connected per controller module, limiting the ability for multi-location or remote interface mirroring. This highlights a restriction when flexibility for multiple HMIs is required.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to connect a second operator panel to the same controller module, allowing both panels to show the same interface concurrently.
